'''mrwaltdog Let Them Make The First Move''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[mrwaltdog]]
* '''Published:''' 1 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core|Ref3-D-nabootheedpalacegeneratorcore.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Naboo Theed Palace Generator Cor.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Noticed some problems with the deck and would like some sugestions. Thankx.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

As you can see I have way to many characters. I don't know what I was thinking. LEt me know which ones I should take out and what to put in. Side note I put all the coies of the big guys I own. Still have a few Darth Vaders but figured 3 would be enough. I currently have 10 sevens to use in lightsaber combat. But with all those characters there are way to many 1 destiny cards. Please help me out.

Thankx
